name: Gazin Tenorm
summary: Near the altar in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, Gazin Tenorm has returned from a dangerous scouting mission in Elwynn Forest.

sections.title: A Scout in the Cathedral
sections.body: Gazin Tenorm remains in the Cathedral of Light, but his thoughts are in Elwynn Forest. He and his close friend Henze Faulk went into the woods to gather proof of the Defias Brotherhood's movements for the royal court. Defias forces ambushed them. Gazin escaped to Stormwind, while Henze was left in mortal danger. Now Gazin seeks a hero of the Light to help his companion.

faq.q: Where can I find Gazin Tenorm?
faq.answer: Gazin Tenorm stands near the back altar inside the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City, among high-ranking clergy and paladin mentors.

faq.q: What happened to Gazin Tenorm in Elwynn Forest?
faq.answer: Defias forces ambushed Gazin and his companion Henze Faulk while they investigated the Brotherhood. Gazin escaped to Stormwind City, but Henze was stranded in the forest.

faq.q: Why was Gazin investigating the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: Gazin and Henze went into Elwynn Forest to gather proof of the Defias Brotherhood's illicit activities for the king's advisors in Stormwind.

faq.q: How does Gazin connect to the Paladin trials?
faq.answer: Duthorian Rall sends aspiring human paladins pursuing the Tome of Divinity to Gazin. Gazin points them toward rescuing Henze Faulk, testing their valor and mercy.

angles.text: As an initiate learning compassion and redemption, you meet Gazin in the Cathedral of Light and help his fallen comrade, Henze Faulk.
As a dwarf, you see Gazin's solidarity with Stormwind. He faces Elwynn's brigands on behalf of the kingdom's advisors.
